entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes exact dependency admission plus source and bundle capability scans; this remains PARTIAL because the full future production dependency and capability surface does not yet exist.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes prohibited source-API scans and semantic zero-import inspection of the embedded WASM module; this remains PARTIAL because later product modules and packaged artifacts are not present to exercise the complete obligation.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes restricted URL and dependency scans, bundle isolation checks, and an offline browser run with zero remote requests; this remains PARTIAL because later course, runtime, and packaged-product surfaces do not yet exist.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes asset-registry schema, provenance, and exact zero-shipped-asset checks; this remains PARTIAL because no later production asset corpus exists to exercise the complete approval workflow.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes clean-room, provenance, and user-facing vendor-mark scans over the admitted foundation; this remains PARTIAL because the later production illustration and prose corpus does not yet exist.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes requirement IP-disposition fields, evidence classification, and matrix truth-state controls; this remains PARTIAL because subject-aware review of later research-derived product requirements remains blocked.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes required lint, type, unit, build, isolation, browser, governance, and mutation checks; this remains PARTIAL because cross-run hosted repetition has not established a general flakiness history.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes deterministic contract/unit checks and repeated offline browser health results for the current foundation; this remains PARTIAL because PLC scan, replay, and product-runtime determinism are later features and have no current proof corpus.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes an active required-test entrypoint and an explicit NOT_STARTED migration truth state; this remains PARTIAL because no migration implementation or identity-and-data preservation corpus exists.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes the foundation UI's typed command path through the isolated worker and WASM health boundary; this remains PARTIAL because lessons and ordinary PLC-domain diagnostic behavior are not implemented.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes loopback, endpoint-string, network-API, and browser-device-API rejection scans; this remains PARTIAL because Virtual Download does not exist, so its behavioral value-rejection proof is not implemented.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes forbidden transport, connector, network, and package-boundary scans; this remains PARTIAL because HMI and InternalTagBus are not implemented, so the product transport invariant has no behavioral proof.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes a non-PLC foundation identity plus bundle scans that reject deployment, network, and device interfaces; this remains PARTIAL because no simulator export pipeline or industrial-deployment negative corpus exists.

entries.targetMilestone: Phase 1 governance foundation
entries.notes: The active local/CI closure gate executes registry/matrix reciprocity, exact check mappings, and the rule that only VERIFIED may count as complete; this remains PARTIAL because the baseline intentionally has zero VERIFIED requirements, so a non-vacuous missing-test-link case remains unexercised.
